messages.author: 35173e9593d63f23
messages.subject: TMB Installation R 3.4.1
parts:
Dear TMB Users,


Things were running fine in TMB, but then I got busy doing other things for a few months only to come back and have the compiler not  work. Probably because I upgraded to a new version of R along the way.

 

Here is the error that I am getting:

 

 

R version 3.4.1 (2017-06-30) -- "Single Candle"

Copyright (C) 2017 The R Foundation for Statistical Computing

Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)

 

R is free software and comes with ABSOLUTELY NO WARRANTY.

You are welcome to redistribute it under certain conditions.

Type 'license()' or 'licence()' for distribution details.

R is a collaborative project with many contributors.

Type 'contributors()' for more information and

'citation()' on how to cite R or R packages in publications.

 

Type 'demo()' for some demos, 'help()' for on-line help, or

'help.start()' for an HTML browser interface to help.

Type 'q()' to quit R.

 

> utils:::menuInstallPkgs()

--- Please select a CRAN mirror for use in this session ---

trying URL 'https://cran.wu.ac.at/bin/windows/contrib/3.4/TMB_1.7.11.zip'

Content type 'application/zip' length 1968496 bytes (1.9 MB)

downloaded 1.9 MB

 

package ‘TMB’ successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked

 

The downloaded binary packages are in

        C:\Users\pjs31\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpmC9irj\downloaded_packages

 

> library(TMB)

 

> setwd("C:\\Users\\pjs31\\Documents\\adcomp-master\\tmb_examples")

 

> compile("linreg.cpp")

c:/Rtools/mingw_64/bin/g++  -I"C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-34~1.1/include" -DNDEBUG -Ic:/~/R/WIN-LI~1/3.4/TMB/include -Ic:/~/R/WIN-LI~1/3.4/RCPPEI~1/include  -DTMB_SAFEBOUNDS -DLIB_UNLOAD=R_unload_linreg  -DTMB_LIB_INIT=R_init_linreg    -I"d:/Compiler/gcc-4.9.3/local330/include"     -O2 -Wall  -mtune=core2 -c linreg.cpp -o linreg.o

c:/Rtools/mingw_64/bin/g++ -shared -s -static-libgcc -o linreg.dll tmp.def linreg.o -Ld:/Compiler/gcc-4.9.3/local330/lib/x64 -Ld:/Compiler/gcc-4.9.3/local330/lib -LC:/PROGRA~1/R/R-34~1.1/bin/x64 -lR

Cannot export EvalADFunObject

: symbol not defined

Cannot export EvalDoubleFunObject

: symbol not defined

Cannot export InfoADFunObject

: symbol not defined

Cannot export MakeADFunObject

: symbol not defined

Cannot export MakeADGradObject

:

Etc, etc.

 

I am using Windows 10.

 

Here is my User Variable PATH: c:/ADMB/admb112-gcc492-win64/bin;c:/gnu/GCC492-win64/bin;c:/gnu/GDB/bin;c:/gnu/EMACS/bin;C:/Rtools/bin

 

I am so sorry to bother you with this. I know this is something minor, but I don't see how to solve this on the TMB installation page.

 

Thank you for your time! 

 

Pat

messages.author: 35173e9593d63f23
messages.subject: Re: TMB Installation R 3.4.1
parts:
So, in the end I just reloaded an older version of R (3.3.1 in my case) and that took care of the problem. For now.

Thanks to Hans Skaug and Bob O'Boyle for helpful suggestions to explore.

Take care!  Pat

messages.author: 258b98968d0ad8b9
messages.subject: Re: TMB Installation R 3.4.1
parts:
We encountered a perhaps similar issue when upgrading a Windows machine today. Problem was solved by upgrading Rtools.
According to the Rtools compatibility table
https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/
the version installed with R 3.3.x is not compatible with R 3.4.x.

On Monday, September 25, 2017 at 8:35:40 PM UTC+2, Patrick Sullivan wrote:
So, in the end I just reloaded an older version of R (3.3.1 in my case) and that took care of the problem. For now.

Take care!  Pat
